subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should shared reply-session recovery be the canonical permanent fix while Discord retains this bounded retry as defense in depth?
rationale: Both open PRs recover the same named conflict at different layers; code review cannot determine whether maintainers want both layers, shared recovery only, or the Discord mitigation landed first.

options.title: Coordinate Both Layers
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 for permanent shared recovery and keep this PR as a bounded, replay-aware Discord retry after exact-head validation.

options.title: Land Discord Mitigation First
options.body: Merge this narrower Discord reliability fix now and decide the broader shared self-heal independently, accepting temporary duplicate recovery policy.

options.title: Pause For Shared Recovery
options.body: Hold or close this PR if the shared-session fix will fully own recovery and makes a channel retry unnecessary.

recommendation.title: Coordinate Both Layers
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 for permanent shared recovery and keep this PR as a bounded, replay-aware Discord retry after exact-head validation.
